diagnosis: The published tarball contains prop-types.js and prop-types.min.js, the UMD bundles built by the `build` script (`yarn umd && yarn umd-min`, invoking browserify/uglifyify/uglifyjs). These are generated by the legacy `prepublish` lifecycle hook in package.json, but modern npm (8.3.0, used here) no longer runs `prepublish` for `npm pack` — only `prepare`/`prepack`/`postpack` and `prepublishOnly` are honored for pack, and none of those exist in this package.json. So a plain `npm pack` (as run by npm/deps/custom + npm/build/pack alone) skips bundle generation entirely, producing a tarball missing those two files, which matches the observed diff. The fix is to explicitly build the UMD bundles from source (using the devDependencies already resolvable via the registry mirror) before packing, rather than relying on the (non-firing) prepublish hook.
